reason: I need the thing fast and it isn't in Baghdad, so the idea fits me, but I'm not paying a brand-new page up front. My cousin lost a deposit exactly like that, and the agent I already use lets me pay when it shows up.
objection: Paying the item price up front by Zain Cash to a page nobody I know has used yet. If they disappear, my money is gone, and two to three weeks is a long time to wait and wonder.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or relative getting an order from them first, or letting me pay everything on delivery, or at least paying at a real office I can walk into.
